second_seed_rule: Train the two lowest-BPB distilled weights (excluding the zero-weight control) from seed 17 with the same recipe and EMA. Compare mean CPU FP32 validation BPB across seeds 17 and 23; use the lower-mean weight for the dual-student pair. Report a reversal as seed instability.
student_selection_rule: Compare EMA-of-seven CPU FP32 validation BPB at equal training targets; record final-checkpoint scores as diagnostics. Do not use the test split for any choice.
dual_student_rule: Package equal-weight probability ensemble of the two independently trained EMA students at the selected soft weight. Compare its CPU FP32 validation BPB and resource use against the two individual students and frozen three-model candidate.
test_policy: Do not score the test split until a final candidate is frozen from validation and resource evidence.
cost_accounting: Count all student runs, failed attempts, teacher training and previous teacher search separately; averaging and ensemble packaging do not erase parent training cost.
